table users {
  id i64 identity
  name varchar(64)
  # the address
  email varchar(120) null default 'a@b'
  primary key (id)
  unique users_name (name)
  index users_email (email desc)
  check users_email_set (email <> '')
  # settings
  settings {
    immutable
  }
}

# orders
table orders {
  id i64 identity
  user_id i64
  primary key (id)
  index orders_user (user_id)
  foreign key orders_user_fk (user_id) references users (id) on delete cascade on update restrict
}

  # here
  users at -5 10
}
